info.title: Pharos API
info.description: Stablecoin analytics API for peg monitoring, liquidity, risk, blacklist events, mint/burn flows, yield, chains, and market-structure data. Protected public routes require X-API-Key. Request email-verified access at https://pharos.watch/api/.

get.description: Materialized chronological feed of typed events (depeg, freeze, score) backed by the tape_events table. Supports filtering by type, coin, severity floor, and time window, plus keyset pagination.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Repeatable: exact event slug (e.g. depeg.opened) or prefix wildcard (depeg.*).

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: Shortcut for type=<class>.* (e.g. class=depeg).

parameters.name: coin
parameters.description: Repeatable canonical stablecoin id filter.

parameters.name: pegCurrency
parameters.description: Filter to events for a specific peg currency.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Filter to events on a specific chain.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive free-text search filter (trimmed and lowercased).

parameters.name: severityFloor
parameters.description: Drop events below this severity.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Lower bound on ts (epoch ms, inclusive).

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Upper bound on ts (epoch ms, inclusive).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor returned as nextCursor.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Default 50, max 500.

parameters.name: includeTotal
parameters.description: When true, computes the exact total count.

200.description: Successful response. See the public API reference for endpoint-specific payload fields.

503.description: Service unavailable or cache not populated

get.description: Freeze and blacklist events with optional uppercase symbol, chain display-name or chain ID, event type, search, sort, exact-count, and pagination filters. Responses include `chainId` join keys; the `chain` query filter is display-name based.

parameters.name: stablecoin
parameters.description: Optional uppercase blacklist-tracker stablecoin symbol filter, for example `USDT` or `USDC`.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Optional exact chain display-name filter, for example `Ethereum` or `Tron`. Use response `chainId` fields for programmatic joins.

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Optional canonical chain-registry ID filter, for example `ethereum` or `tron`. When both `chain` and `chainId` are supplied, they must identify the same chain.

parameters.name: eventType
parameters.description: Optional event type filter.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Optional case-insensitive affected-address substring search.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort field. Defaults to `date`.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Sort direction. Defaults to `desc`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of events to return. Defaults to 1000; `0` maps to the default.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination offset. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: includeTotal
parameters.description: When false, skips the exact total count.

200.description: Successful response. See the public API reference for endpoint-specific payload fields.

503.description: Service unavailable or cache not populated

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Required for protected public routes on https://api.pharos.watch.

JsonValue.description: Endpoint-specific JSON response. See https://pharos.watch/about/api/ for detailed contracts.

benchmarks.description: Benchmark registry keyed by currency such as USD, EUR, and CHF.

updatedAt.description: Unix seconds when the rankings were last computed.

provenance.description: Snapshot-level source, benchmark, pool, and safety provenance.

methodology.description: Yield methodology envelope when emitted by the rankings publisher.

provenance.description: Selected-source provenance, benchmark state, and source-switch metadata.

sourceRole.description: Worker-derived role explaining how the selected source participates in arbitration.

rankChangeAttribution.description: Optional rank-change attribution with previous rank/PYS, delta, primary driver, and driver contribution hints.

AltYieldSource.description: Retained non-selected yield source row for the same stablecoin.

selectionRank.description: Rank inside the worker's source-candidate ordering for this stablecoin.

YieldAlternateSummary.description: Deterministic summary of retained non-selected source rows.

YieldAlternateSourceSummary.description: Compact alternate source summary used by ranking rows.

YieldPublicDecisionLedger.description: Bounded public source-selection decision evidence for a ranking row.

YieldPublicDecisionAlternative.description: Compact retained alternate inside a row decision ledger.

YieldSourceRisk.description: Nested source-risk evidence used by PYS v8. Missing or unknown evidence is neutral.

sourceRiskPenalty.description: PYS v8 source-risk multiplier; runtime clamps populated values to the active range.

venueRiskTier.description: `unknown` remains neutral and should be treated as missing evidence.

YieldPublicationMetadata.description: Generation metadata for published yield payloads.

updatedAt.description: Unix seconds for the methodology snapshot backing the manifest.

sourceKey.description: Exact runtime source key when the strategy publishes a joinable yield_history/rankings source; null for disabled or runtime-resolved strategies.

sourceKeyPattern.description: Human-readable source-key pattern or would-be key for runtime-resolved or disabled strategies.

updatedAt.description: Unix seconds for the methodology snapshot backing the manifest entry.
